title: Make bridge and SDS READMEs CLI-first
description: Reorder install and usage, move optional MCP to the bottom, and correct stale workflow and UI documentation.

notes.text: Reorganized both READMEs around installation and CLI quickstart, moved optional MCP setup to the end. Bridge now documents native TS setup early, default-apply rename, guarded five-minute caches, workspace lifecycle, concise unified Zed setup and sandbox errors. SDS now correctly documents Kanban default, themes, breadcrumbs/back, copy IDs and dependency links; removed stale initial-commit statement. Checked source entry points, JSON examples, local links and diff whitespace. Documentation-only; no runtime changes or computer use.
